description: The settings window may read and save settings, pause capturing, read and change whether Satchel opens at login, clear history, close itself, list apps (names and icons, plus the native app chooser) for the excluded-apps picker, read the bundled third-party licence notices and listen to Satchel's events. It may read the update status, check for an update and start installing one; Rust does all of it. Nothing else: no clip content, no paste, no plugin permissions (not the updater's either).
